gates.detail: 30-day Universal Cycle + No Token Left Behind policy built
LinkedAsset available to developers; OmniBuildz is inside existing 19% FlyWheel
Streamflow-compatible non-cancellable/non-transferable schedules defined; SDK/on-chain proof still required
5% genesis + 40% staged reserve; +5% quote commitment rule; 100% permanent LP-lock target
1% claim-vault policy defined; no old candidate wallet is auto-approved
Full 62.5M / 25% is classified in a protected Chance Vault; unknown recipients do not block genesis
Canonical PNEX mainnet mint does not yet exist
No approved PHENIX token image URI is currently locked in the build
Liquidity, FlyWheel, developer vesting, Chance and legacy-claim destinations require final addresses/program accounts
Genesis SOL amount and derived opening price require owner-funded final configuration
Create/read-back proof of disposable Streamflow vesting contract required
Disposable burn must prove confirmed supply reduction and Worldz Proof receipt
Disposable 5% pool must prove 75 bps, dynamic fee OFF, permanent lock, first swap and fee claim
Actual claimed fee receipt must reconcile before routing execution
Final treasury/FlyWheel/program authorities must satisfy Worldz multisig policy
Release runbooks and applicable legal/regulatory gate remain required
JayJayTeamDev final transaction review/signing authorization required

releaseRule: Mainnet launch is permitted only when every gate is PASS or PASS_ONCHAIN and mainnetExecutionEnabled is explicitly switched by a separately reviewed release commit.
